name: East cliff terrace
purpose: Step out of the warm halls onto a windy sea-cliff ledge: surf below, and a round glass lens in the paving glowing orange where the Magma Glass Slide shaft drops through the rock beneath your feet.

ceiling_profile.note: Open sky; changing-hall wall on the west, sea cliff on the east and south.

hero.why: A thick glass lens set in the paving over a light-well into the slide shaft (H4): orange lava light and the flicker of the glass slide shine up through it and its steam. It is the brightest, warmest thing on a cold blue terrace and the only ground-level hint of the slide and Lava Stair below.

anchored.why: Bronze ring rail around the lens; the gap to the north lets you step up to the kerb.
Seat at the SE corner facing the sea stacks.
Red maple at the cliff-path mouth (plan 31, H3): a warm silhouette marking the way on.

sightlines.see: An orange-lit steam column rising from the lens 20 m south-east; the sea beyond.
North-east: the cape lantern at the shoulder of the sea-cliff path.
The cliff path running east between post lanterns toward the cape lantern.

concept.match: Plan 31's east terrace (H3-H4): stone paving, lanterns at the cliff rail, surf glowing white below to the east, red tree on the left.

lights.why: On the cliff rail; dark gaps between, so the oculus glow wins.
Hero brightest; light comes from below.

dressing.why: South drop (east of the south terrace).
Corner pines against the hall wall.

mood.key: orange lens on a blue terrace
mood.palette: deep blue sea light, white surf, lava orange from below, amber posts
mood.mist: steam rising from the oculus, sea spray haze
